title: Reconstruction & Rebuild | Gold Water Fire, Phoenix, AZ Metro
description: Repair and rebuild after fire or water damage: framing, drywall, flooring, and finishes, led by our in-house construction team. Phoenix, AZ metro area. Call (480) 999-3339.
intro: Repair and rebuild damaged structures back to move-in condition: framing, drywall, flooring, and finishes, led by our in-house construction team.

photo.alt: Reconstruction crew framing new interior walls during a residential rebuild

sections.heading: Why reconstruction stays in-house
sections.body: Once mitigation is complete, most properties still need real construction work: framing, drywall, flooring, paint, and finishes. Gold Water Fire's reconstruction work is led by Construction Manager Brandon Gurr and Reconstruction Team Lead Johnny, so the same company that handled the cleanup handles the rebuild, with no second contractor to coordinate.

cards.heading: Structural repair
cards.body: Framing, subfloor, and drywall repair or replacement.

cards.heading: Flooring and finishes
cards.body: Flooring, trim, paint, and finish work to bring rooms back to move-in condition.

cards.heading: Final walkthrough
cards.body: We walk the completed work with you before we call the job done.

faqs.q: Who leads Gold Water Fire's reconstruction work?
faqs.a: Construction Manager Brandon Gurr and Reconstruction Team Lead Johnny lead reconstruction and rebuild projects.

faqs.q: Do I need to hire a separate contractor for repairs after mitigation?
faqs.a: No. Reconstruction is handled in-house by the same company that does the water or fire mitigation, so there's no second contractor to coordinate.

faqs.q: What areas do you serve for reconstruction?
faqs.a: The greater Phoenix, Arizona metro area, from Peoria and Surprise in the northwest to San Tan Valley and Apache Junction in the southeast, and the cities in between.

cta.heading: Ready to talk through your rebuild?
cta.body: Call Gold Water Fire to get started.
